### Academic Integrity

All work submitted in this course must be your own. Collaboration is [encouraged / not permitted] on [specific assignments]. Violations of academic integrity will be handled in accordance with [Institution]'s [Academic Integrity Policy](link).

### Accessibility and Accommodations

[Institution] is committed to providing an accessible learning environment for all students. Students who require accommodations should contact the [Disability Services Office](link) and provide documentation. Please share your accommodation letter with me as early in the semester as possible so we can arrange support promptly.

If you encounter accessibility barriers in any course materials — including this website — please contact me directly at [email\@institution.edu](mailto:email@institution.edu) so I can provide an accessible alternative.

This course website is built to meet [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/). If you find a barrier that prevents you from accessing content, please let me know.

### Student Wellbeing

Graduate and undergraduate students alike can experience significant stress and mental health challenges. [Institution] offers [Counseling and Psychological Services](link). You are always welcome to speak with me if you are struggling.

### Communication

The best way to reach me is by email at [email\@institution.edu](mailto:email@institution.edu). I aim to respond within [24/48] hours on business days. For questions that others may share, please consider posting to [the course discussion forum / Discord / Piazza] so classmates can benefit from the answer.
